messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法直接查詢或提供即時的交通資訊。若您需要最新的交通狀況，建議使用專門的交通服務（例如 Google Maps、Waze 或當地交通局的實時更新）。如果您想要將「紐約」這個位置轉換為具體座標或地址，我可以協助進行地理編碼。請告訴我您是否需要此類幫助！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to use the geocode_address function? Actually we might want to get traffic data. But the only tool available is geocode_address. That transforms a description of a location to a location on Earth. It doesn't provide traffic info. There's no function to get traffic. So we cannot answer directly. We can respond that we don't have real-time traffic data. Maybe ask clarifying question? Or we could say we can't fetch real-time traffic. Probably best to explain limitation.
